Consider the finite region bounded by the curve y=−6+8x−2x2 and the x-axis, shown above. What integral gives the volume of the solid generated when this region is rotated 2π radians about the y-axis?

a
4π∫13(−3+4x−x2)2dx
b
4π∫13(−3+4x−x2)dx
c
4∫13(−3+4x−x2)2dx
d
4∫13(−3+4x−x2)dx
e
4π∫13(−3x+4x2−x3)dx
